name: Ugly Crab 3
author: deepak16375
description: Gradient rounded sky-blue button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #ffffff to #000000, starts the slide animation (shimmering).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ugly Crab 3</title>
<style>
/* Ugly Crab 3 by deepak16375 — https://uiverse.io/deepak16375/ugly-crab-3 */
.button {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border: 0px;
  color: white;
  background-color: #1877f2;
  padding: 1rem 2rem;
  border-radius: 15px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:hover {
  background-image: linear-gradient(90deg,
		#B799FF 0%,
		#ACBCFF 50%,
		#AEE2FF 75%,
		#E6FFFD 100%);
  color: black;
  animation: slide 10s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes slide {
  100% {
    background-position: 50rem;
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Hover me!
</button>

</body>
</html>
